recipe.title: Warm lentil salad with radishes and orange
steps: Toast the pumpkin seeds in a dry saucepan for 2 to 3 minutes, until they pop, then tip out.
Add the lentils to the pan, cover well with water and bring to the boil. Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, until tender but holding their shape.
Meanwhile, put the onion in a large bowl with the vinegar and a pinch of salt. Cut the peel and pith from the oranges, slice into rounds and squeeze the ends over the onion.
Whisk in the oil, mustard, garlic, cumin and the rest of the salt.
Drain the lentils and stir them into the dressing while warm.
Fold in the radishes, parsley and watercress. Top with the orange, seeds and plenty of black pepper.
